frozen.decision: Frozen on the project owner's go-ahead, 14 Nov 2026, after the live draft run passed the five Gate 2 checks (docs/runs/GR-001-run.md). Science-owner sign-off on SDR-001 is still pending. The pin is the run id on the LIVE stack, which includes the DEM and SPICE kernel hashes: any change to the request, settings, DEM identity, kernel set or algorithm version changes it, and check_freeze then refuses to run: create GR-002, never edit this file.

purpose: The common scientific reference for integration tests, performance figures, screenshots, the live demo and exported evidence (product spec 6, implementation spec 14.2).
sites_status: DECLARED REFERENCE SCENARIO. The three sites are rule-chosen points (latitude -89.5 deg at 0, 120 and 240 deg east, fixed by a symmetric rule before any terrain or illumination result was seen). They are NOT candidate landing sites and carry no mission provenance. Decided for GR-001 by the project owner on 14 Nov 2026 (SDR-001 D-09); science-owner sign-off is still pending. Real candidate sites would need their own coordinate and terrain provenance and a new reference version (GR-002).

selection_reasons.mission.start_utc: 2027-01-10 00:00 UTC, the round date already used by the recorded fixtures and RUN-001, inside the kernel, Horizons and DEM coverage; fixed before looking at any result (S-11, D-08). Not chosen to contain or avoid an outage.
selection_reasons.mission.duration_s: seven days, the scenario length used throughout
selection_reasons.requirements: scenario values (Sun 60 %, Earth 50 %), not mission rules
selection_reasons.terrain: primary DEM release recommended in D-01, 150 km radius, 0.1 deg azimuth step (D-05), 2 m mast
selection_reasons.sites: latitude -89.5 deg at 0, 120 and 240 deg east: an equal-spacing rule chosen before looking at any result (RUN-001 selection rule, S-11, D-09). Chosen so that no site can be said to be cherry-picked. Not candidate sites.

freeze_rule: Once frozen, this file is never edited. Any change to provider settings, observer conventions, DEM identity, horizon parameters, event policy or algorithm version gives a new run_id and must become GR-002.
